summary: Pressing Back, Forward or reloading the page now puts you back exactly where you were, with the same sections open and your place on the screen. If you had typed something but not saved it, it waits in the boxes with a quiet "Not saved yet" and one way to undo it.
points: A save no longer jumps the page or closes sections you had open
Confirmations you could not see are shown at the bottom and fade by themselves
A form you left open is opened again when you come back
Undo links come back with their page while your plan is unchanged
numbers: Applies to every page at once

summary: Tapping twice now does just one thing, and a tap aimed at a screen that has already gone is ignored. A new page shows its name right away and says "Working it out..." if it is slow, and the menu's Find a page box keeps what you typed and opens the best match.
points: Whole-word matches rank first in the page search
The top bar shows a back arrow whenever Back stays in the app
A page opened from Needs attention names its way back at the bottom
A web address that names no page now says so instead of showing the Dashboard
numbers: Applies to every page at once

summary: A line on the shared workboard says the first round of the touch and typing checks has landed.
